categories.main_business_segments: Service Corporation International (SCI) operates two primary business segments: funeral services and cemetery operations. The funeral segment provides professional services related to funerals and cremations, while the cemetery segment offers cemetery property interment rights and related merchandise and services. Both segments serve customers at the time of need and on a preneed (pre-arranged) basis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SCI leverages a combination of physical locations (funeral homes, cemeteries, crematoria) and digital platforms to deliver its services. The company utilizes proprietary customer relationship management systems, digital sales tools (such as HMIS+ and Beacon), and modernized websites to enhance customer experience and sales efficiency. Operational efficiencies are achieved through shared resources, standardized processes, and technology-enabled service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SCI primarily serves individuals and families in need of funeral, cremation, and cemetery services, both at the time of death and in advance through preneed arrangements. Its customer base spans diverse religious, ethnic, and cultural backgrounds, with a significant focus on the aging Baby Boomer population. The company also targets customers interested in preplanning and securing future funeral and cemetery needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: SCI is the largest deathcare provider in North America, operating 1,474 funeral service locations and 490 cemeteries across 44 U.S. states, eight Canadian provinces, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico. The company’s operations are geographically diversified, with significant presence in major states such as California, Texas, and Florida, as well as key Canadian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: SCI operates at the downstream end of the deathcare supply chain, directly providing services and merchandise to end customers. The company manages the delivery of funeral, cremation, and cemetery services, as well as the sale of related merchandise, and coordinates with suppliers for caskets, urns, markers, and other goods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: SCI’s strategic priorities are to grow revenue, leverage its unparalleled scale, and invest capital in acquisitions and new builds. The company is focused on remaining relevant to evolving customer preferences, expanding preneed sales, and enhancing digital and technology capabilities. Innovation themes include personalized service offerings, digital customer engagement, and expanding cremation and memorialization options.
categories.revenue_model: SCI generates revenue through the sale of funeral and cemetery services and merchandise, both at the time of need and on a preneed basis. Revenue streams include atneed and preneed contracts, property and merchandise sales, service fees, and investment income from trust funds. Preneed sales provide a significant backlog of future revenue, enhancing stability and predictability.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SCI is the market leader in North America with an estimated 15-16% share of the fragmented deathcare industry, which is otherwise dominated by locally-owned, independent operators. Key public competitors include Carriage Services, Hillenbrand, Matthews International, and Park Lawn Corporation. SCI differentiates itself through its scale, national branding (Dignity Memorial), and integrated network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, SCI reported total revenue of $4.1 billion and net income attributable to common stockholders of $565 million. The company serves over 600,000 families annually and maintains a $13.7 billion backlog of future preneed revenue. SCI has demonstrated steady growth through acquisitions, preneed sales expansion, and capital investments, with strong operating cash flow and a disciplined capital allocation strategy.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SCI offers a unique value proposition through its national scale, trusted Dignity Memorial brand, and ability to provide comprehensive, personalized, and culturally sensitive deathcare services. The company emphasizes convenience, professionalism, and compassion, supported by digital tools and technology-enabled customer experiences. Its preneed offerings, broad geographic reach, and integrated service model further differentiate SCI from local competitors.
